b: When crappie get finicky, successful anglers know that smaller can be better. Whether you’re targeting suspended fish on forward-facing sonar, shooting docks, or working brush piles in clear water, matching the size and behavior of natural forage often makes all the difference. That’s exactly why the new Bobby Garland Fry Ball was created. Built specifically for finesse presentations, this tiny 0.75-inch bait is engineered to trigger bites when larger plastics stop producing.
